notes.title: Holy Martyr Neophytos MAC Support & Updates
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We're happy to announce that we've pushed out a major update for Saint Neophytos.

[list]
[*] Mac support now available. Play on Mac or PC!
[*] General Player Movement Fixes
[*] Ledge Grab detection updates
[*] Swimming is now enabled
[*] Auto-Run Cutscenes is now available as an option, and is on by default
[*] "Play All" mode is available in the Library after completing the Game (Accessed through the Main Menu).
[*] General graphical updates and a new Icon of the Saint
[/list]

A Spanish translation is also in the works, and is almost ready to be integrated. We will post another announcement once Spanish is available as a playable language.

Thank you for your continued support!
